Data.purpose: Provide one reusable visual area for cards and gallery items, starting with a themed placeholder and later accepting a dedicated final visual without changing page structure.
rules: The media slot position and dimensions remain stable when replacing a placeholder with a final asset.
Placeholder and final asset selection are configuration data, not hard-coded business logic.
Projects should generate final visuals as a coherent batch after the associated studios/cockpits are functionally stable.
Themeable SVG should use currentColor or semantic CSS variables where practical.
A list/table view may suppress large media while preserving the same logical item.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Reusable media slot for cards/gallery with placeholder-first workflow.
